d.seg: ഞാൻ ടെലഗ്രാം ആയിട്ട് തരാം അതിലേക്ക് കണക്ട് ആക്കാമോ
d.tr: I will give you my Telegram, can we connect there?
d.ctx: The expert offers to provide their Telegram handle to the user to continue the conversation outside the app. The user responds by asking if they only use WhatsApp.
d.j: The expert is proposing to move the conversation to an external app (Telegram).

d.tr: I only have WhatsApp, no Telegram.
d.ctx: The user explains they do not have Telegram and only use WhatsApp. The expert then asks what to do.
d.j: The user is denying the use of the proposed platform, which is a refusal of the platform move.

d.ctx: The expert reiterates the suggestion to use Telegram if the user has it. The user does not respond to this.
d.j: The expert is again proposing to move the conversation to an external app (Telegram).
